description: This file defines the jQuery UI Controlgroup widget (version 1.14.1), which visually groups form control widgets and manages their initialization, styling, and behavior.

classes.name: ui.controlgroup
classes.description: A jQuery UI widget that groups form controls visually and functionally.

methods.name: _create
methods.description: Initializes the controlgroup widget and enhances the element.

methods.name: _enhance
methods.description: Sets ARIA role and refreshes the widget.

methods.name: _destroy
methods.description: Cleans up the widget, removes data and ARIA attributes.

methods.name: _initWidgets
methods.description: Initializes child widgets within the controlgroup based on options.

methods.name: _callChildMethod
methods.description: Calls a specified method on all child widgets.

methods.name: _updateCornerClass
methods.description: Updates CSS classes for corner styling of controlgroup items.

methods.name: _buildSimpleOptions
methods.description: Builds options for child widgets based on position and orientation.

methods.name: _checkboxradioOptions
methods.description: Generates options for checkbox and radio widgets.

methods.name: _selectmenuOptions
methods.description: Generates options for select menu widgets.

methods.name: _resolveClassesValues
methods.description: Resolves and merges CSS classes for child widgets.

methods.name: _setOption
methods.description: Handles updates to widget options, including direction and disabled state.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the controlgroup and its child widgets, updating classes and states.
